description: Formation of a vehicle access on the public pathway.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: A181HS-V4-1. Received: 21/05/2024
A181HS-V4-2, A181HS-V4-3, A181HS-V4-4. Received: 29/07/2024

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - Either side of the vehicle access hereby approved, visibility splay areas (the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, with a splay of at least 2.4 metres x 2.4 metres) shall be provided before the access and parking area is brought into use.  These areas shall be kept clear of any obstructions to visibility greater than 600 mm in height, including shrubs, planting, boundary walls, fences, gates, other means of enclosure or other structures or objects at all times.
Reason:  To ensure adequate visibility for drivers entering and leaving the site in the interests of pedestrian and vehicle safety.

Condition : 4 - Prior to first use of the crossover hereby permitted, the 600mm high front boundary wall shall have been erected and the 1.2 metre wide pedestrian pathway and front garden area laid out and landscaped as per the approved drawings. These provisions shall be maintained as such thereafter in perpetuity.
Reason: In the interests of the character of the area and highway and pedestrian safety
